acknowledgedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.

batchId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

lastAcceptedSequence.description: Last accepted batch sequence for the session, when relevant (resume semantics).

reasonDetail.description: Human-readable supplement; never replaces the stable reason code.

resumeFromSequence.description: Sequence the client should resend from (conflict/gap recovery).
